text:
Riley Park: Alerting: we started seeing a spike in TLS handshake failures at the ingress-proxy layer for eu1 private deployments at ~01:10 UTC. Some customers reported failed model uploads and SDK connection errors. Opening thread for ops + customer comms.

Nora Greene: Seen it too. Errors show up as TLS_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA and TLS handshake timeouts. Is this limited to private control plane or also hosted endpoints?

Riley Park: Initial scope: primarily private deployments in eu1 that validate our leaf cert chain against customer CA bundles. Hosted API endpoints unaffected.

ops-bot: mitigation action: re-provisioned ingress cert bundle to eu1-proxy-2 at 01:22 UTC, rolled proxy config to safe-mode (fail-open disabled) at 01:24 UTC.

Jia Huang: Quick root cause hypothesis: automated cert rotation job skipped intermediate bundle fetch due to transient S3 auth error; proxy accepted an incomplete chain.

Nora Greene: Any customer impact numbers? which accounts?

Riley Park: Impact: ~15 private deployments across 5 customers experienced upload failures or short-lived disconnects. Error rate peaked 01:12-01:26 UTC. No model corruption and uploads retried successfully after proxy roll.

CS-bot: Draft customer status posted to #support-digest. Link: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2898009000 (contains impact window and workaround).

Jia Huang: Commands for infra follow-up:

```bash
# check cert bundle validity on proxies
rdwctl proxy cert show --region eu1 --proxy eu1-proxy-* --fields bundle,expires,chain_ok
# re-fetch intermediate CA and validate
rdwctl cert fetch --src s3://rdw-certstore/intermediates/ --id int-2026-04
```

ops-bot: incident-severity: SEV3 (customer-impacting, transient).

Nora Greene: Mitigations completed: re-fetched intermediate chain, redeployed cert bundles to eu1 proxies, enabled additional validation in rotation job. All eu1 uploads succeeding as of 01:36 UTC.

Riley Park: Post-incident actions: 1) add retries + backoff to intermediate fetch task, 2) add CI check to validate full chain post-rotation, 3) notify affected customers with timeline + apology.

Jia Huang: I'll open PRs for the rotation-job retries and CI gate, and attach logs.

CS-bot: Assigned CS follow-ups: Nora to send customer bulletin and offer incident call if requested.

Riley Park: ETA for RCA + timeline: EOD. Will include S3 auth logs and rotation job traces. Keeping thread pinned until RCA posted. :pin: 

status-bot: Monitoring note: watch for certificate rotation failures for next 72h; alert threshold set to 2 failed rotations per hour.

Nora Greene: Thanks team. I'll coordinate messaging with Legal for any sensitive customers. Will post bulletin link here when live. :white_check_mark:
